data.description:
Compose the whole page: the pinned shell, URL state, fetching, every state, the pager, keyword emphasis, focus management, and the integration tests. Then prove it against the real API. Spec: docs/SPEC.md §7.1–7.6, §8 (SearchPage list). Design: BRANDING.md §4.2 (shell), §5.9 (states), §1 ("App, not document").

Why: this is the "wired together end to end" deliverable. Everything before it is a part; this is the product. Its validation is the real end-to-end check for the frontend.

Scope:
- src/pages/SearchPage.tsx composes Header, FilterBar, LoadingLine, StatusLine, the results region (ListingList, NoResults or ErrorState), and Pager in the §4.2 grid from BC-7; the results region is the only scroller.
- Wiring: useSearchParamsState feeds useListingSearch; FilterBar `value` comes from the URL, `onSearch` pushes new params (page reset), `onClear` clears the URL, Pager `onChange` pushes page; keyword tokens for emphasis come from the URL state; `serverErrors` come from the 'invalid' state; Try again re-runs the last request; cities from useCities.
- Initial load with an empty URL performs a default search (all listings, newest first). After a page change move focus to the results heading. Keep previous results on screen while loading, on invalid input and on error, per §5.9.
- Remove the BC-7 placeholders; App.tsx renders SearchPage.
- Integration tests with stubbed fetch and the BC-8 fixtures: loading then success renders cards and status; loading then empty renders NoResults and `0 results`; a 400 with min_gt_max marks both price fields and keeps the previous list; a 500 and a network failure render ErrorState and Try again re-fetches; page change issues a new request with page=2, aborts the previous one, and the first card reads `No. 11`; popstate restores page 1; the default search fires on mount.

Acceptance:
- All §8 SearchPage tests green; `make check` green for both halves.
- With api and web running the full flow works in a real browser.

Validation (required, this is the frontend's e2e gate): run the API (native or compose) and the web app; in a browser via the c11-browser skill: (1) default load shows 12 results, newest first, `12 results · newest first`; (2) Target budget 450000 and City Springfield gives 4 results ranked with A1 as No. 1 and `ranked for $450,000`; (3) Min price 500000 and Max price 400000 marks both fields with the message under Max price and sends no request; (4) Keyword `pets` emphasizes matches in descriptions; (5) with pageSize=3 in the URL, page 2 shows No. 4 and the back button returns to page 1; (6) stop the API, search, see `Couldn't load results.`, start the API, Try again recovers; (7) the document never scrolls, only the results region. Attach screenshots or the browser transcript with --role validation.
data.title: SearchPage: compose shell, wire URL state and fetch, all states, pager; integration tests and browser e2e

data.body:
From BC-10 (results surface), handoff notes for BC-12's planner:
- Focus after page change: import RESULTS_HEADING_ID from src/components/ListingList/ListingList; after pushing the new page call document.getElementById(RESULTS_HEADING_ID)?.focus(). The heading is a visually hidden h2 'Results' with tabIndex=-1 (BRANDING has no visible results heading). Test: expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Results' })).toHaveFocus().
- Card keyword emphasis: keywordTokens={splitKeyword(params.keyword)} from src/format/keyword.
- ListingList root is <section aria-labelledby=results-heading aria-live=polite> (ticket requirement). App.tsx's <main aria-label=Results aria-live=polite> would then create nested polite live regions and two 'Results' landmarks: keep exactly one live region in the results area (e.g. drop aria-live from main and rename/unlabel it, or host the live region on the container that also renders NoResults/ErrorState and drop it from ListingList), and put aria-busy on the container. Decide in BC-12's plan.
- NoResults/ErrorState carry no live region of their own; ListingList owns the 6px top padding so NoResults sits exactly 96px from the top.

Plan-review triage (art_01M4W9XKQPJ88MBHYFZT8JNEVX, PASS, headless run that started before decision 04:02Z and finished in time): 6 minors, all obvious, resolved in the plan's 'Plan-Review Cycle 1 Resolutions' block. (1) anchors: delegator merged master @76d6a97 (BC-10 landed) and feat/BC-9 @13ae060, HEAD c52a505; review hold now BC-9 only. (2) stale list flashing back during retry after an error: add a guard keeping ErrorState through loading/invalid that follows an error, plus test T12; ticket's 'keep previous on error' wording yields to SPEC §7.5/BRANDING §5.9. (3) test harness: queue the hook's refetch of held results (T7/T8/T2). (4) validation item 6 starts from /. (5) Pager/StatusLine page mismatch for one request: accepted, handed to BC-14. (6) nested polite live regions: kept as a decision, handed to BC-14. No evolutionary or complex findings.

From BC-9 review (art_01M4WADP7WCHKFV2AKQQBQJFVG, nit 3): FilterBar handles Enter on its two selects (City, Status) by submitting (SPEC 7.4 'Enter in any field submits'), preventDefault suppresses the native open-on-Enter; Space / Alt+Down still open the picker. Worth one click in the browser e2e: in Firefox (in-content dropdown) confirm choosing an option with Enter does not also submit. FilterBar labels for getByLabelText: Min price, Max price, Min bedrooms, City, Keyword, Target budget, Status; form is role=search named 'Filters'; props serverErrors?: FieldError[] | undefined.

Implementation f9c9cfc (impl sub-agent): SearchPage.tsx +118, SearchPage.test.tsx +615 (T0-T12 + T12b), fixtures add-only +148, App.tsx/App.test.tsx, shell.module.css dead .row removed. No component edits. Deviation: Resolution 2 guard holds the error view through any loading/invalid until success/empty (the 'last settled' wording could never match invalid); T12b covers 400-after-error. Delegator re-ran the gate on f9c9cfc: make check exit 0 (396 FE tests, golangci 0 issues), npm run build exit 0, tree clean. HOLD before review: BC-9 not landed (in_validation).

Review cycle 1 routing (art_01M4WBDHN5ZS9CS97WXRSXYEQ0, PASS-WITH-NITS @5ac2397, fable sub-agent): Minor T8 late-response assertion gap -> fix; Nit T11 rank/page meta mismatch -> fix. Both test-only; fix via implementer sub-agent, then fresh re-review naming the new HEAD (stays in review).

Review cycle 2 PASS (art_01M4WBW2080NK351Q4Q2JPYFJG, fable sub-agent) @bb78854: both cycle-1 findings resolved (326f1cd), master merge (BC-6, backend-only) clean, no new findings. Moving to in_validation.

BC-12 complete, LAND-READY at bb78854 (contains master f0dd9c3). Built: frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx composes Header, FilterBar + LoadingLine (row-2 wrapper), StatusLine, results <main> (only scroller, aria-live polite + aria-busy) and Pager in the §4.2 grid; URL state -> useListingSearch; FilterBar value/onSearch/onClear/serverErrors (invalid only; malformed_query via the unmapped alert line); keyword tokens from URL via splitKeyword; Try again -> retry; focus to results heading after page change; previous list kept during loading/invalid; ErrorState replaces the list on error and is held through a retry/400 until a 2xx (plan-review resolution 2). App.tsx renders SearchPage; dead .row removed from shell.module.css; fixtures.ts add-only BC-12 block. Tests: SearchPage.test.tsx 14 (T0-T12 + T12b), App.test rewritten; FE total 396. No component edits, no SPEC edits. Deviations: resolution-2 guard wording interpreted as 'hold through any loading/invalid after error' (T12b). Findings routed: plan review 6 minors fixed/recorded (art_01M4W9XKQPJ88MBHYFZT8JNEVX); review cycle 1 PASS-WITH-NITS (art_01M4WBDHN5ZS9CS97WXRSXYEQ0) both test nits fixed in 326f1cd; cycle 2 PASS (art_01M4WBW2080NK351Q4Q2JPYFJG) @bb78854. Validation 7/7 PASS in a c11 browser on 18012/15112 (art_01M4WC9P46N4142PWSVQ1JMF0J + 9 screenshots). Handed to BC-14 by comment: pager/status page mismatch during a page-change load, nested polite live regions, first-load LoadingLine vs §5.9, cards cut flush under the status line, stale 'direct child of the shell' comment in FilterBar.module.css. Validator notes: the c11 browser cannot send real keystrokes (text entered via native-setter + input event); with the API down the Vite proxy answers 502 (plan said 500), handled identically. No follow-up tickets created. Gate on bb78854: make check exit 0 (396 FE tests, Go 5 pkgs -race ok, golangci 0 issues), npm run build exit 0.
